messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Dedicated pool GPU exhaustion detected for tenant 'tenant-stratus-001' (StratusPharm) in eu-west-1. Pool: dp-tenant-stratus-001
incident-bot: Symptoms: 502s from runtime, queue growth > 200, 95th latency spike > 3s. Autoscaler failing to provision new nodes due to quota. Incident ID: INC-2026-2331
oncall-alex: paging SREs + ENG-OPS. I'm on it, standing by. :rotating_light:
customer-success-lee: FYI customer support ticket #SR-8742 opened by StratusPharm at 10:12Z — they report API timeouts and 429s. Customer on call is Amanda (StratusMobility)
sre-jordan: I'm looking at metrics — queue length per pod:
```
pod-1: queue=250
pod-2: queue=240
pod-3: queue=0 (drained)
GPU util avg=98%
```

sre-jordan: autoscaler log tail:
```
[13:02:11] attempt_allocate -> quota_exceeded: requested_instances=4, available=0
[13:02:12] backoff
```
eng-ops-maya: quick checklist: can we burst into shared spare capacity? we have a spare pool spares-eu-1 with 8 gpus. Need account approval for cross-tenant burst. Running `redwoodctl pool describe dp-tenant-stratus-001`
oncall-alex: tagging account-ps for approval @account-ps-alan — need one-time permission to use spares-eu-1 for up to 20 minutes to avoid customer SLA breach
account-ps-alan: on it. checking contract: StratusPharm enterprise IO contract allows emergency burst but requires post-fact billing. I approve 20m burst if SRE+Eng confirm rollback plan
eng-ops-maya: rollback plan: revoke burst, evict best-effort jobs, and route new requests to hosted fallback model-sm-1. Commands:
```
# request burst
redwoodctl pools burst --from spares-eu-1 --to dp-tenant-stratus-001 --gpus 4 --duration 20m
# evict best-effort
redwoodctl jobs evict --pool spares-eu-1 --label best-effort=true
# route fallback
api-router set-route --tenant tenant-stratus-001 --fallback model-sm-1
```
oncall-alex: SREs: can we evict our internal best-effort RL jobs from spares without data loss?
infra-nikhil: yes — jobs are checkpointed. eviction ~30s. I can run eviction now and start burst after.
sre-jordan: one more ask: confirm model compatibility — smaller model-sm-1 supports same API but 95% of calls are latency-sensitive. We should throttle to 80% p95 to avoid quality regressions.
customer-success-lee: Amanda on customer call: she wants confirmed ETA to resolution. Can we give 15 mins?
eng-ops-maya: if we approve burst now, we should see queues drain in ~3-5 minutes; overall ETA 12-15m
account-ps-alan: customer notified: told them we are authorizing emergency burst, will follow up with billing note. :+1:
infra-nikhil: running evict command now
```
redwoodctl jobs evict --pool spares-eu-1 --label best-effort=true --wait
```
(small delay)
infra-nikhil: evict done. freed 4 GPUs in spares-eu-1
eng-ops-maya: executing burst:
```
redwoodctl pools burst --from spares-eu-1 --to dp-tenant-stratus-001 --gpus 4 --duration 20m
```
eng-ops-maya: burst request accepted. provisioning started, instances launching
sre-jordan: metrics: queue length decreasing -> 250 -> 120 -> 45
oncall-alex: update to customer: queue draining, we expect normal service within 15m
customer-success-lee: Amanda: "thanks, watching now" — keeping customer on call
sre-jordan: note: we saw intermittent allocation failures due to cloud quota; quota team notified to raise soft guardrails
eng-ops-maya: temporary mitigation: implement request throttling policy to 85% while burst active
```
api-router set-throttle --tenant tenant-stratus-001 --rate 85%
```
account-ps-alan: confirm we will stop burst at 20m unless extended; set manual approval for extension
oncall-alex: handing off to infra-nikhil for monitoring the burst period and rollback. I'm stepping off oncall now — handover to infra-nikhil :wave:
infra-nikhil: taking over. I'll monitor logs and CPU/GPU allocs. alert if queue doesn't go under 10 in 20m
sre-jordan: 10m later: p95 latency back to baseline, errors down to <1%. queue ~2-3
infra-nikhil: stopping burst now (2m early) to reduce cost
```
redwoodctl pools burst-cancel --pool dp-tenant-stratus-001
```
infra-nikhil: burst stopped, spares returned. running postmortem checklist: capture autoscaler failure, quota error, and propose to add prewarmed nodes for this tenant
eng-ops-maya: action items:
- raise ticket with cloud quota team (owner: nikhil)
- propose pre-warm policy for dp-tenant-stratus-001 (owner: maya)
- communicate billing note to StratusPharm (owner: alan)
- add fallback route test to chaos suite (owner: jordan)
customer-success-lee: Customer on call thanks team. Amanda said she'll close SR if stable for 24h
oncall-alex: closing incident channel, moving to postmortem doc link pending
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-2331 moved to RESOLVED by infra-nikhil. Duration: ~32m. Tags: dedicated-pool, burst, quota, customer-impact
